palette_rationale: Preserve the reviewed white wings, cream hair, blue and white clothing, gold staff, source face and black outline from approved Idle.
reference: Own DSTS chr087 Angemon mesh and native clips; PMDO registry supplies action names and event fields.
ground_policy_note: Intentional winged hover with fixed row-54 Idle shadow. Actions use proportional 96px framing and row-70 shadow; preserve source flight gap and never trim Idle or Physical Attack.

actions.name: Walk
actions.pose_evidence: Own winged travel cycle with staff and dangling legs; endpoint excluded.

actions.name: Attack
actions.pose_evidence: Own staff-led aerial strike and recovery. Physical Attack is never trimmed.

actions.name: Shoot
actions.pose_evidence: Own braced staff release gesture; no projectile, ray or glow is invented.

actions.name: Sleep
actions.pose_evidence: Own folded-wing rest loop while hovering; source face retained without painted eyelids.

actions.name: Hurt
actions.pose_evidence: Own ordinary aerial recoil; extreme alternate damage clips remain unused.

actions.name: Swing
actions.pose_evidence: Own broad horizontal staff sweep and recovery.

actions.name: Double
actions.pose_evidence: Two visual cycles of the native staff-led strike; one engine HitFrame.

actions.name: Hop
actions.pose_evidence: Own upward wing beat and return; flight gap is source-native with no artificial offset.

actions.name: Charge
actions.pose_evidence: Own wing-and-staff gather and recovery; no aura is invented.

actions.name: Rotate
actions.pose_evidence: Own ready motion with whole-view yaw for engine Rotate; endpoint excluded.
